messages:
alex: FYI found another delayed ingestion window from 2026-03-10 22:00 to 2026-03-11 02:30 UTC. looks like token events were queued but not applied to ledger. initial estimate ~1.4M tokens. opening follow-up for postmortem + remediation tracking. cc @priya @taylor
priya: thanks. do we know why the consumer fell behind this time vs last week? any overlap with INC-4821?
alex: different root cause: this one was caused by a temporary spike in malformed batching from a partner connector that caused retries and exponential backoff; consumer kept checkpointing but backlog grew. ticket: https://redwood.internal/ops/INC-4897
acct-bot: Alert INC-4897: token_ingest_backlog_exceeded  backlog_size=1620000 runbook: /docs/runbooks/token-backlog
taylor: I'll own the remediation pipeline. plan: (A) isolate affected message ranges, (B) run replay with idempotent writer and sequence checks, (C) ledger reconciliation, (D) invoice adjustments.
beth: noted. I'll prep a billing spreadsheet and queue manual approvals for >$3k adjustments. can someone add impacted_accounts list?
priya: creating an interim report. quick grep shows ~32 accounts with deltas >1000 tokens. uploading partial list to: https://s3.internal/redwood/deltas/2198765432-partial.csv
taylor: replay job queued PR #914, will run in staging then prod. throttle to 150rps. ETA for full replay: 8h after approval.
alex: owners: taylor -> replay & reconciliation scripts, priya -> customer outreach + accounting coord, beth -> invoice reissue queue + approvals, alex -> PM and postmortem writeup.
beth: accounting legal: confirmed reissue policy; need audit trail for each adjustment. please include event ids for the ledger entries.
priya: outreach draft to customers posted: https://redwood.internal/docs/cs/delayed-credits-2198765432. I'll loop CS on enterprise ones first.
taylor: staging replay passed smoke tests at 2198767600. starting prod replay at 2198768000. logs: /var/logs/replay/2198765432.log
acct-bot: Replay job 2198765432 started  progress=0%
acct-bot: Replay job 2198765432 progress=45%
priya: quick check of sample accounts (10) looks correct; token deltas match issuer logs. uploading verification sheet: https://s3.internal/redwood/verify/2198765432-checks.csv
beth: marking 5 enterprise customers for manual invoice reissue (IDs attached). putting approvals into accounting queue.
taylor: replay finished at 2198769200. final delta: 1,370,842 tokens across 32 accounts. full csv: https://s3.internal/redwood/deltas/2198765432.csv
alex: excellent. timeline proposal for postmortem actions: 1) Add stricter validation on partner connector batching (owner: infra@taylor, due: 2026-03-25), 2) Improve monitoring thresholds + SLA alerts (owner: observability@alex, due: 2026-03-22), 3) Automated invoice-suggestion workflow to reduce manual reissues (owner: billing@beth, due: 2026-04-05).
priya: adding a recurring audit to detect repeated partner spikes (recurrence rule: weekly) and will include in postmortem.
beth: accounting will reissue invoices for the 5 enterprise customers once approvals are in. small credits (<$3k) applied automatically tonight.
taylor: updating ticket INC-4897 with replay artifacts, logs, PR #914, and reconciliation csv.
alex: scheduling follow-up review 2026-03-23 09:30 for closure and to finalize the postmortem doc. will include action owner table and checklist.
priya: thanks everyone. closing loop after the audit runs tomorrow.
